WITH active_equip AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT om."equipRef" 
    FROM "OperationMaintenance" om 
    WHERE om."OPER_status" = 'Active'
),
eer_calc AS (
    SELECT e."EQUIP_CODE", 
           (et."type_indices"->>'performance_score')::real + e."RELIAB_IDX") / 2.0 * (1 - (et."type_indices"->>'environmental_impact_idx')::real / 100.0) AS EER
    FROM "Equipment" e
    JOIN active_equip ae ON e."EQUIP_CODE" = ae."equipRef"
    JOIN "EquipmentType" et ON e."EquipType" = et."EquipType"
),
ors_calc AS (
    SELECT om."equipRef",
           CASE WHEN om."OPER_status" = 'Active' THEN 10 * (1 - om."OPER_hours" / om."maintCycleHrs")
                WHEN om."OPER_status" = 'Standby' THEN 5 * (1 - om."OPER_hours" / om."maintCycleHrs")
                ELSE 0 END AS ORS
    FROM "OperationMaintenance" om
    JOIN active_equip ae ON om."equipRef" = ae."equipRef"
),
cri_calc AS (
    SELECT c."equipRef",
           CASE c."antenna_stat"
               WHEN 'Error' THEN 0
               WHEN 'Warning' THEN 5
               WHEN 'Normal' THEN 10
               ELSE 0
           END * (1 - COALESCE(c."netLatency_ms", 0) / 1000.0) AS CRI
    FROM "Communication" c
    JOIN active_equip ae ON c."equipRef" = ae."equipRef"
)
SELECT AVG(ee.EER * 0.4 + o.ORS * 0.4 + cr.CRI * 0.2) AS cori_avg
FROM eer_calc ee
JOIN ors_calc o ON ee."EQUIP_CODE" = o."equipRef"
LEFT JOIN cri_calc cr ON ee."EQUIP_CODE" = cr."equipRef";

WITH active_equip AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT om."equipRef" 
    FROM "OperationMaintenance" om 
    WHERE om."OPER_status" = 'Active'
),
eer_calc AS (
    SELECT e."EQUIP_CODE", 
           ((et."type_indices"->>'performance_score')::real + e."RELIAB_IDX") / 2.0 * (1 - (et."type_indices"->>'environmental_impact_idx')::real / 100.0) AS EER
    FROM "Equipment" e
    JOIN active_equip ae ON e."EQUIP_CODE" = ae."equipRef"
    JOIN "EquipmentType" et ON e."EquipType" = et."EquipType"
),
ors_calc AS (
    SELECT om."equipRef",
           CASE WHEN om."OPER_status" = 'Active' THEN 10 * (1 - om."OPER_hours" / om."maintCycleHrs")
                WHEN om."OPER_status" = 'Standby' THEN 5 * (1 - om."OPER_hours" / om."maintCycleHrs")
                ELSE 0 END AS ORS
    FROM "OperationMaintenance" om
    JOIN active_equip ae ON om."equipRef" = ae."equipRef"
),
cri_calc AS (
    SELECT c."equipRef",
           CASE c."antenna_stat"
               WHEN 'Error' THEN 0
               WHEN 'Warning' THEN 5
               WHEN 'Normal' THEN 10
               ELSE 0
           END * (1 - COALESCE(c."netLatency_ms", 0) / 1000.0) AS CRI
    FROM "Communication" c
    JOIN active_equip ae ON c."equipRef" = ae."equipRef"
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(ee.EER * 0.4 + o.ORS * 0.4 + cr.CRI * 0.2)::numeric, 2) AS overall_reliability
FROM eer_calc ee
JOIN ors_calc o ON ee."EQUIP_CODE" = o."equipRef"
LEFT JOIN cri_calc cr ON ee."EQUIP_CODE" = cr."equipRef";
